featureAudit.chronology: game_date strictly earlier than target; all same-date targets emitted before updates

populationAudit.integrityQuarantineRule: Preserve raw bytes; exclude complete game before any feature-history update; never infer component stats from final score.
populationAudit.nonFranchiseExhibitionRule: Exclude non-NBA team codes before regular-season modeling even when source season_type is 2.

totalReboundIdentity.definition: source-defined total_rebounds preserved separately; no equality requirement
totalReboundIdentity.featureUse: OREB and DREB directly; total_rebounds excluded from four-factor features
